name: Sex with Stalin
source: As a young time traveler, you receive the opportunity to meet the greatest dictator of all time — Stalin. And then what? Everything's up to you! Speak with Joseph, reveal his most hidden secrets, give him advice, and help the vozhd come to world domination! Or... show that mustache guy what real love is!
translation: 作为一名年轻的时间旅行者，你获得了与有史以来最伟大的独裁者斯大林见面的机会。然后呢？一切由你决定！与约瑟夫交谈，揭开他藏得最深的秘密，为他出谋划策，帮助这位领袖统治世界！或者……让那个留胡子的家伙见识什么才是真爱！
